name: Service à la française
summary: A way to serve a meal: all the dishes of one service stand on the table together, and the guests take from the dishes near them. A new service replaces the old one.
how: Set all the dishes of one service on the table at the same time.
Place the dishes in a symmetric pattern that a plan on paper shows.
Clear the whole service at once and set the next service in its place.

origin.note: Medieval feasts put many dishes on the table at once, in two or three services.

adoptions.via: Scappi and the banquet cooks of Italy planned each service as a pattern of dishes.
La Varenne wrote his book for a table of services of dishes in a fixed order.
Carême drew table plans for each service and published them.
